title: Road Construction Project - Haritpur District
content:
Subject: Stalled PWD Road Construction from Haritpur to Neelam Valley

File Notes (Pages 1-15 summary):
The project was initiated on 12-05-2022 with a sanctioned budget of ₹45 Crores. Work progressed smoothly until 18-09-2023 when it was halted due to land acquisition disputes raised by residents of village Madhavpur. Currently, 40% of the physical work is complete. The contractor has raised bills for the completed work, which are pending clearance. The District Magistrate has requested an immediate resolution to prevent cost overruns.

summary_bullets: Project initiated on 12-05-2022 with a ₹45 Cr budget.
Work halted on 18-09-2023 due to land disputes in Madhavpur.
Contractor payments are pending and require clearance to avoid cost overruns.
ai_generated.draft_om:
OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Sub: Resumption of Haritpur road construction.
Ref: FILE-PWD-2023-089

1. It is directed that the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) resolve the land acquisition disputes in Madhavpur village at the earliest.
2. The pending contractor bills for the 40% completed work should be processed and cleared subject to standard verification.

By Order,
[Officer Designation]
